synthetic_validation_paper.description: Scaled counterpart of the paper's synthetic validation (Table 1): forward-moving monocular camera through a near-static scene whose subjects make small smooth unintended motions; render every input camera pose at evaluator-chosen freeze instants (every 8th frame, private offset) and compare with the true scene state at that instant. Validity gate (zero inference overhead): a submission is a frozen Gaussian state per timestamp with at most 64 primitives rendered by the evaluator's fixed rasterizer; exceeding the budget or any invalid value fails the run (worst values everywhere). Non-underscore results are this gym's hidden-test reference values; underscore results are the paper's reported numbers.

psnr.description: Peak signal-to-noise ratio (dB) of each freeze-time video (every camera pose rendered at one freeze instant) against the true scene state at that instant; averaged over freeze instants and scenes. Capped monotonically at 100 dB (MSE floor 1e-10).

ssim.description: Windowed structural similarity (Gaussian window, sigma 1.5 px, along the image line, per channel) of freeze-time renders against the target; averaged over views, freeze instants and scenes. Range [-1, 1].

lpips.description: Perceptual-error proxy: mean absolute RGB error averaged over a 4-level resolution pyramid (2x average pooling). Stands in for LPIPS, which needs 2D images and a pretrained network.

fvd.description: Video-distance proxy: 1000 x mean absolute difference between the view-to-view temporal derivatives of the rendered and target freeze-time videos (flicker / temporal inconsistency). Stands in for FVD.

edge_mae.description: Mean absolute error of image-axis gradients; penalises blur, ghosting and double contours. Gym metric, not reported in the paper.

motion_preservation_error.description: Constraint metric for user-selectable freeze instants: mean absolute error between the rendered change and the true change of the freeze-time video from one evaluated freeze instant to the next. A reconstruction that drops timestamp control (one static scene for every instant) scores the full true change.

synthetic_validation_paper._paper_results_note: Paper Table 1 (synthetic Blender scenes, 4DGaussians vs 4DGaussians + Splannequin, 2D images, true LPIPS/FVD). Not on this gym's scale (1D image lines, proxy LPIPS/FVD); kept for reference only.

synthetic_large_motion.description: Stress test from the paper's stated limitation (Sec. 7: the method assumes nearly static scenes and degrades under larger motion; motion thresholds left for future work). Same protocol, validity gate and metrics as synthetic_validation_paper, but subject motion is about 2.7x larger and decorrelates about 2x faster. No paper numbers exist for this setting; results are this gym's hidden-test reference values.

_paper_unscored_results.note: Paper results this gym cannot measure (no real Mannequin-Challenge videos, CQA/COVER/IQA models or user study are available offline, and ablations are properties of the paper's method rather than of a submission). Kept unchanged for reference; not scored.
_paper_unscored_results.zero_inference_overhead_claim: Inference overhead 0.0 for Splannequin vs its base model (enforced in this gym as the primitive-budget validity gate).
